headline: Valero Energy (VLO) Eyes Earnings And Crude Supply Shifts, Is The Stock Fully Priced?
summary: Dividend affirmation and earnings expectations put Valero Energy in focus Valero Energy (VLO) is back on investors’ radar after its board affirmed a regular quarterly dividend of $1.20 per share, as the market also watches for upcoming earnings and evolving crude supply arrangements.
